opening.argument: The video’s central activity is a practical Galaxy S10 charging-port repair, presented as a start-to-finish demonstration. The speaker expressly explains, “Today I'm going to show you how to replace the. Charging port on a Galaxy S10,” and the footage shows a microscope close-up of the circuit board and a hot-air tool applied to the phone assembly. The video also promotes paid training for opening a cellphone repair shop, including a stated $39.99 price and claims about profits, unlocking phones, and parts sourcing. Those promotional statements do not, on the available evidence, establish deception or harm; they remain ancillary to the observable repair instruction and should not displace the video’s educational and operational purpose.
